items.title: How cancer cells protect themselves from a toxin they produce
items.text: Cancer cells must protect themselves from the harmful substances they produce as they grow. Now, researchers have identified how they neutralize one of these substances, formaldehyde, while keeping another defense against cell death intact. The findings suggest a way to attack both defenses together, and the next step is to find out whether it could become a treatment.
